question: Does pretraining a board-aware network improve nomination of missed exact-move forks on reviewed game positions?
primary: Use the two reviewed classical cohorts separately. Among geometry-eligible moves the legacy root verifier missed, compare reviewed positives and reviewed negatives at the same floor-quarter shortlist budget. Include uncertain cases in the budget. Report all known-case average precision and app coverage. Prior releases inspected these cohorts for other methods; this comparison is an exploratory transfer of a frozen new model.
secondary: Independent reviewed puzzle audit and game/mirrored-board-disjoint engine-teacher test. Report same-board positive/negative pair ordering and known-case average precision. Source solution preference is a pretraining proxy.
arms: prior handcrafted reply network where saved
same spatial network with solution-vs-legal-alternative pretraining
input: Each candidate receives the same two 6,000-node Stockfish replies. Use legal proposal and up to four plies from each independent reply. Normalise boards to side-to-move. A 120,000-node exact-payoff teacher is used only as a label.
pretraining: Use only the puzzle training split. Exclude source games or mirrored boards present in exact-model validation/test or in transfer. For up to the first two solver turns rank the published solution above a deterministic geometry/check/capture/piece-type-matched legal alternative. Alternate solutions can exist and the supervision is weak.
fitting: Three seeds 17, 59, 97. Keep training and validation grouped by puzzle source game and colour-normalised board. Early-stop on known validation log loss. Use BCE plus a within-board margin for opposite known labels. Transfer labels never enter fitting, feature normalisation or checkpoint selection.
advancement: Require a higher aggregate classical positive yield than the best simple control with no more reviewed negatives and no lower yield in either cohort. Compare trained-from-scratch to isolate the contribution of pretraining. If this gate passes, use a new event-disjoint prospective frozen review before any app integration. Puzzle-teacher success alone does not pass.
runtime: Measure pretraining and fitting once offline, and per-candidate warm CPU inference including spatial input preparation. No production model or change in Stockfish budget at this stage.
